rounds.strengths: 顶栏资源胶囊+右侧入口轨+底栏PLAY分区清楚，控件壳与庭院场景分层明确，已是商业HUD而非插画海报；PLAY描边/体积/投影/字重可读，未压任何脸部
rounds.defects: 顶部三组资源条贴近画面边缘，横向空间略拥挤；左侧仅有Settings，与右侧四枚按钮形成轻微视觉失衡。背景景深偏强，城堡主体稍显糊软，与前景极锐利的HUD存在一点割裂；部分按钮的高光和阴影较厚，使边框略显臃肿。路径在城堡入口附近的透视收束与局部石块尺度变化不够稳定。
rounds.next_fix: 优先增加顶部安全边距并统一三组资源条的间隔与宽度，同时微调左右功能区配重；适度恢复城堡关键轮廓与入口细节，降低HUD边框和投影厚度，再校正道路石块向远处缩小的节奏。

- 项目私有知识卡 (Private Layer):
  · [tech-9slice] 九宫格切图: 四角固定、中心可拉伸；中心禁止复杂装饰。
  · [tech-celshade] 赛璐珞分层: 硬边色块分层，高光形状干净，层数克制。

LAYOUT ZONES (locked): TOP BAR ~12% height — horizontal resource pills for coins / gems / lives with cream-white rounded capsules, gold coin icon, green gem, red heart, bold dark readable numbers, subtle inner shade + soft drop shadow, thick warm outline; TOP-LEFT settings gear square + TOP-RIGHT shop bag square as side chrome with blue glass bevel, white stroke, short label under; LEFT or RIGHT SIDE RAIL mid-height — 2–3 vertical entry buttons (events/album/mail) with same bevel craft, not floating stickers. MAIN CTA ZONE bottom ~22%: large PLAY primary button (rounded 3D soft-plastic slab, orange-to-magenta gel gradient, thick light outline, top specular, contact shadow) PLUS secondary Level / Continue pill; BOTH sit on the ground plane of the scene (carpet/grass continues under buttons — scene under chrome, not a detached empty tray). CTA CLEAR OF FACES: king or mascot may appear mid-left or mid-back but faces stay unobstructed; PLAY never covers eyes/nose/mouth. CONTROL CRAFT for every chrome piece: explicit outer stroke, volumetric bevel, soft drop shadow, heavy rounded sans bold type — tactile soft plastic, not flat stickers, not painterly poster text. Copy only: PLAY, Level, short resource digits; NO garbled letters, NO fake Lorem, NO random Latin soup. Fail-at-glance rejects: full-bleed narrative key-art poster with floating buttons; or CTA pressed over character faces. rounds.strengths: 左右侧栏配重到位(左Settings+Album/右Shop+Events+Mail)；国王站中左路径，PLAY在下三分之一，脸部完全不被CTA遮挡；仍是软塑胶商业HUD壳叠场景，不是插画海报
rounds.defects: 底部 PLAY 按钮体量偏大，明显遮压场景并削弱城堡与角色的叙事中心；右侧三枚入口相对左侧两枚略显失衡。背景花草、石路和建筑细节密度较高，与高饱和 HUD 叠加后局部略拥挤；部分小型城堡构件、栅栏及远景植被边缘偏软，精度不完全一致。
rounds.next_fix: 将 PLAY 按钮缩小约10%并略向下移，适度压暗或虚化按钮后方草地与花丛；重新校准左右功能入口的垂直节奏和视觉重量，同时统一远景建筑、栅栏及植被边缘的清晰度与材质简化程度。
